text.name: rf_pda_side_info_soil
text.text:
[EN] Soil Fertilizer
This table lists every field you own. One row = one field.
Columns: Field #, Area, N/P/K (% of a healthy target), Status (Good / Fair / Poor), Fertilizer need (short cue for what still looks short).
Click a row. Treatment (below) is the plan for that field: - PRODUCT = what to buy (first is preferred; "or ..." is an alternate) - RATE = amount per area / TOTAL = amount for this field - Selected names the field; Next (under it) says what to do first
How to apply: dry goods (urea, MAP, potash, lime) go through a fertilizer spreader; liquids go in a sprayer tank. If pH and nutrients both show, fix lime or gypsum first so nutrients can work. Weed, pest, or disease lines mean spray (or weed mechanically) before you expect a full crop.
Start with the weakest Status, open Treatment, follow Next, then the rest of the list.

text.name: rf_pda_side_info_crop_stress
text.text:
[EN] Crop Stress
This screen is the Crop Stress desk. Each line is one field you own.
The table shows Field, Crop, Moisture, Stress, Irrigated, and Status. Moisture is how wet the soil is. Stress is how hard the crop is fighting dry spells. Irrigated says a system can reach this field. Status is Healthy, Warning, or Critical.
Click a row. Field Detail on the left coaches that field and Next says the first job. AGRONOMIST on the right lists the top risk fields. PIVOT below drives the irrigation system for the selected field.
On PIVOT, grey remotes are locked until the step before them is done. Open the door, then power, then the rest. An empty seat means no pivot covers this field.
Start with Critical Status, follow Next, then work up the list.
Irrigator kit (shop): pump + Rainstar + pull bar. Unfold, pull the gun out, turn it on over a field.

text.text: [EN] Moisture low - irrigation is on; recheck Moisture as it recovers.

text.name: cs_rf_pda_next_warning_covered
text.text: [EN] Moisture low - irrigate soon. Coverage is on this field; confirm the system is running.

text.name: cs_rf_pda_next_warning_uncovered
text.text: [EN] Moisture low - irrigate soon (coverage / WATER sprayer).

text.name: cs_rf_pda_next_no_coverage
text.text: [EN] No irrigation coverage - add a system, or spray WATER for a temporary boost.

text.name: cs_rf_pda_next_covered_idle
text.text: [EN] Irrigation covers this field - confirm it is running when dry, then recheck Moisture.

text.name: cs_rf_pda_next_looking_good
text.text: [EN] Looking good - recheck later; handle Critical fields first.

text.name: cs_rf_pda_agro_empty

text.name: status_RAINSTAR_REEL_COMPLETE_SHUTDOWN
text.text: [EN] Hose fully reeled in - cart locked and motor pump switched off.

text.name: warning_RAINSTAR_CART_ATTACHED
text.text: [EN] Detach the tractor from the sprinkler cart before starting retraction.

text.name: warning_RAINSTAR_HOSE_10M
text.text: [EN] Warning: only 10 m of hose remain on the reel.

text.name: warning_RAINSTAR_HOSE_30M

text.name: warning_RAINSTAR_HOSE_MAX

text.name: warning_RAINSTAR_HOSE_NOT_EXTENDED

text.name: warning_RAINSTAR_PUMP_NOT_CONNECTED
text.text: [EN] Connect the motor pump to the Rainstar first.

text.name: warning_RAINSTAR_PUMP_NOT_RUNNING
text.text: [EN] Start the motor pump before retracting the hose.

text.name: warning_RAINSTAR_SELECT_WORKMODE
text.text: [EN] Select work mode before starting hose retraction.

text.name: cs_rainstar_needs_pump
text.text: [EN] Connect the supply hose from the pump and start the pump. This reel runs on pump pressure, not a tractor.

text.name: cs_playkit_pump_power_teach
text.text: [EN] The pump is the power. Hitch the reel only to tow it: to spray, run the hose from the pump, start the pump, then switch the reel on. Stop the pump or pull the hose and the spray stops.
